title: Who stopped me? (an agent's message, swapped out)
text: You were stopped at 17:56:44 while idle, and I don't yet know by whom. Suspect your own builder's reaper, if it ran against the live Servex: check that first and tell me. Both minions have since finished (minion-lifecycle-build at 17:57, and minion-lifecycle-study, now idle); their "done" messages were lost with you. Read their results with the Servex logs (agent-minion-lifecycle-build.jsonl, agent-minion-lifecycle-study.jsonl in %LOCALAPPDATA%\lew42\servex\logs, the last "result" line) and the worktree. Then judge, merge with merge.mjs, restart Servex (sustain --restart, as your last step), and land with the before/after counts. If the reaper stopped you, that is a bug to fix before merging: it must never stop a task mastermind whose task isn't landed.
